vector_memory.semantic_summary: This component defines the abstract contract for integrating any physics engine into the Omega simulation loop. It establishes interfaces like PhysicsBackend and PhysicsBackendWorld to decouple high-level game logic from low-level physics solver details. It provides structured types for describing rigid bodies, colliders, and raycast results, ensuring a standardized interaction pattern across different backend implementations like Rapier. The component focuses purely on defining the service layer boundary without containing complex operational logic.
